_comment: Vacuity demonstrator (needs the sby backend). Under assume A1 (enable always LOW), PV holds only because its antecedent (en) is never true — a false 'proof'. Its cover CV (en high) is UNREACHABLE, so the anti-vacuity guard must report PV as VACUOUS, not PROVEN. yosys-sat can't see this (it ignores the assume AND can't discharge covers), so this is a sby-only capability.

properties.rationale: An environmental constraint that makes PV's antecedent unreachable.

properties.summary: when enabled, count equals 5 (vacuously true: en never high)
properties.rationale: Passes only because en is never high under A1 — a vacuous pass the guard must catch.
Reachability witness for PV; its unreachability is exactly what makes PV vacuous.
